steps.content: [WhiteSands - Daytime]
A small sand ship races through the desert. The engine is running at full power, trying to shake off the sand beasts in hot pursuit.
Korryn is steering, while the injured townsfolk crowd in the middle. This bloated little sand ship is severely overloaded, yet it speeds along in determination.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Now's the time, they're catching up! Start attacking!
Hella and a few other townsfolk stand at the back of the ship, shooting at the monsters. The battle doesn't look promising.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Two down, five more to go!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The remaining firepower is only enough to take down one more. How far is that place you mentioned?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Almost there! Don't worry!
Korryn floors the pedal, making the sand ship drift sideways and leaving the sand beasts behind.
Boom! The sand ship hits the ground with a loud crash. At the same time, a bullet strikes a scrawny sand beast in the head, downing it instantly in the dust.
But as one sand beast falls, countless others swarm over.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Don't worry, we'll be there soon! We'll be fine!
[WhiteSands - Night] (Can switch to another map. Please align with the previous shelter!) (Memory filter)

A few hours earlier
In the temporary shelter

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Right now, we've got three enemies: the desert bandits, the security team, and the unpredictable Tide of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: The Tide of Ashes is the most dangerous. We have no Hypercubes left. If we run into it, we're dead.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: So, we need to get Hypercubes first. I stashed some "emergency supplies" near Tuco for times like these...
A branch scratches the sand, adding a few circles to the map.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Not here. This was where Scotch and his team found me. They've stationed a small squad here.
A shoe wipes away one circle. Two remain, not far apart.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I remember this part. We'd have to cross the sand beasts' territory. They might attack. Let's go to the third spot.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Don't worry. I've got a plan.
Korryn dusts off the sand from her knees, tosses the branch aside, and stands up.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: As long as the ship goes fast enough, and we shoot accurately enough from the back. Once we reach that big sandstone, they won't catch us.
(Memory filter ends)
[WhiteSands - Daytime]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Korryn, all the sand beasts behind us are down!
Hella wants to call out, but notices a frowning Mira reloading next to her. A speeding shadow is looming larger... it's another sand ship!

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Oh no, it's the desert bandits! They've found us!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh? Didn't we drive them off already?!
The desert bandits' ship quickly approaches. Hella doesn't have time to raise her gun before seeing the familiar metal glint on the enemy's ship.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Get down, they're gonna shoot!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Hahahahah! Time for our revenge! Beat 'em while they're down! Go go go!!
Steel cables fire, embedding their barbs deep into Tuco's sand ship. The two ships get pulled closer. The desert bandits cackle maniacally as they climb towards the Tuco ship along the cables.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Get your filthy paws off, you bastards!
Hella kicks them and smashes them with the butt of her rifle, but there are too many bandits for her to hold off alone.
Bang! A gunshot explodes in her ear, and a Mania-laced bullet pierces the steel cable.
Korryn came to the sand ship's rear when Hella didn't notice, snapping all the cables with two shots. She then sweeps away a desert bandit trying to sneak up on Hella.
Hella doesn't have time to react before she sees Korryn nimbly flip and jump onto the ship's edge.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, what are you doing?!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Sorry, little Hella, I'm gonna trick you again.
Korryn reaches out, ruffles Hella's hair, then falls back without hesitation.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Take care of everyone for me. I'm leaving the rest to you.

steps.speaker: Maggie
steps.content: Korryn! Don't...!
Korryn's figure swiftly disappears into the dust stirred up by the rear of the ship.
The next second, a burst of light erupts!
A streak of light cuts through the air, striking the bow of the desert bandit's ship... then, the bullet skews, forcing the pursuing ship to a halt.
It's Korryn! She raises her long gun, forming a one-person defensive line for Tuco's retreat.
The people on the ship go into an uproar. Hella tightens her grip on the edge of the sand ship, then reach out to stop the townsfolk behind her. She takes a deep breath and shouts:

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't think you can just dump this mess on me and leave! Come back alive!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You got it? You big bastard!!!
The desert bandits swarm like fish to bait, but Korryn remains unmoved, like a boulder in a river.
She raises her long gun without looking back, but gestures to Hella behind her.
Clenching her fist, she points to the sky... She won't break her promise this time.
